blurb: Explore the mile-high city with a private guide, seeing the city's highlights, and finishing at a local brewery where your guide will grab you around before finishing your tour. Denver appeals to everyone, especially outdoor types and adventurers. It's the jumping-off point for ski resorts in the nearby Rocky Mountains. On your private walking tour of Denver, you'll learn about its unique culture, history and why it's so appealing. This Rocky Mountain city boasts a lively food and artisanal beer scene as well as some great cultural hot spots including Larimer Square, the city's oldest block and the Denver Art Museum home to the mansion of famous Titanic survivor Molly Brown. From Denver Art Museum to the huge blue bear holding up the convention centre building, this private tour will give you a taster of what makes Denver such a popular destination.
